answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 61 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The ember register is checked at draw time, hollow lists the eligible set, and cipher seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 61 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 26 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
